name: Ilse
source:
Lake Castro City's Police Detective and Brice’s colleague.
Strikingly nicer and more well kept then her partner, Ilse can easily get on people's good side.
Despite being the “senior” among the two, as she’s the one driving them around and explaining and organizing stuff, she also appears to be a bit clumsy. She complements it by having an upbeat and caring personality, which allows her to almost instantly befriend Noah.
